svg.title: Memory use of terminal coding agents, lower is better
svg.desc: Two bar charts of resident memory. With one active session: AlphaCode 27.8 MB, Codex CLI 140.0, pi 144.4, Cursor Agent 214.9, Antigravity CLI 243.7, GitHub Copilot CLI 333.3, OpenCode 371.5, Claude Code 386.6. With ten concurrent sessions: AlphaCode 117.0 MB, Codex CLI 334.8, pi 833.0, Cursor Agent 1632.4, Antigravity CLI 1021.2, GitHub Copilot CLI 1756.5, OpenCode 3237.2, Claude Code 2300.6. Historical measurements, not an independent benchmark.
svg.text: AlphaCode stays light as sessions multiply
Resident memory in megabytes. Shorter bars are better.
Historical measurements, not an independent benchmark. Tools change quickly, so re-measure on your own machine before you rely on them.
